final_objective.what_system_does: SuperEzio Financeiro should behave as a local investment desk: the user gives Bob a mandate, Bob opens a case, consults data, MathHub, Genie, Deep, experts, guardrails, portfolio, history, and only then produces an operational verdict or gated paper order.
final_objective.who_it_is_for: Marco/F51 and future operators who need a disciplined AI trading desk, not a fast chatbot.
final_objective.main_user_flow: Open http://127.0.0.1:8002, select or request an asset/opportunity/order, let the case run through scan/data/math/committee/guardrails, then review Bob's verdict and paper/live gate result.
final_objective.start_command: $env:PYTHONPATH='src'; python -m agent_server.main with llama-server on 8082 and TWS paper on 7497
final_objective.proof_output: Readiness is proven by live traces where actionable financial mandates show data collection or scan, MathHub coverage, six-expert committee, Trinity deliberation, guardrails, portfolio context, Bob verdict, and a single gated paper/live order path.

what_was_done: Audited the math stack: MathHub, risk metrics, technical indicators, DCF proxy, CrisisMath, penny momentum backtest, and trading loss functions.
Confirmed the orchestration gap: auto_full_analysis only pre-collects for market_scan/ticker_analysis, while the current passthrough route is agent.
Raised slow-study defaults so financial cases are not cut short by 30-90 second assumptions.
Set Bob local provider timeout to 600 seconds and gateway timeout to 600 seconds.
Raised DeepSeek/Gemini expert timeouts to 240 seconds and expert dialogue budget to 240 seconds / 2000 tokens.
Raised data collection defaults to 180 seconds, scanner LLM timeout to 600 seconds, scanner enrichment timeout to 60 seconds per item, and scan stage deadline to 180 seconds.
Aligned run_experts tool with the full six-member committee by including social_forensics.
Adjusted Bob's dynamic prompt contract: general chat can avoid tools, but financial mandates/ticker cases/trade/order/Sentimento Vivo/portfolio decisions require tools and evidence before verdict.
Updated the local .env runtime timeouts without exposing secrets and restarted the API.

compile: python -m py_compile collector.py expert_dialogue.py providers.py tool_executor.py agent.py and core math modules: passed

Provider timeout probe: deepseek=240s, gemini=240s, agent=600s, ceo_fallback_glm=300s, gateway=600s.
known_unresolved_design_gap: Financial case routing still needs a stronger typed-intent/case contract so passthrough route=agent cannot make the full desk optional.
Order execution still needs a single authoritative path instead of split parser/tool behavior.
Sentimento Vivo click still needs to become a real case submission if the intended behavior is 'Bob received this signal'.

risks: Longer timeouts are correct for money decisions but increase latency and can tie up local/cloud providers longer.
Prompt contract improvement is not the same as hard routing; the next step must enforce case semantics in code.
NewsAPI is currently returning HTTP 429 in server logs, so news enrichment may be degraded independently of timeout changes.
next_step: Implement the case/mandate architecture: typed envelopes for user mandates and Genie signals, mandatory full desk pipeline for actionable financial cases, and one broker execution path.
